services.description: Our Sports Injury Rehabilitation program helps athletes recover from injuries, improve mobility, and regain strength through targeted physiotherapy techniques.
Geriatric Physiotherapy focuses on improving mobility, balance, and strength in older adults to enhance their quality of life and independence.
This program aids in the recovery of fractured bones and traumatic injuries by improving joint mobility, muscle strength, and overall function.
Post-Surgical Physiotherapy helps patients regain strength and mobility after surgery through personalized rehabilitation programs and exercises.
Pulmonary Rehabilitation is designed for individuals with lung conditions, helping them improve breathing, endurance, and overall lung function.
Respiratory Physiotherapy helps individuals with breathing difficulties by using airway clearance techniques and exercises to improve lung capacity.
Neurological Physiotherapy focuses on helping individuals with neurological conditions such as stroke, Parkinson's, and multiple sclerosis regain movement and function.
